overview: The MetaZoo Mothman is a 1/1 (token #1017) from the Steve Aoki x Gal Yosef collaboration, created September 20th, 2021.

It sold in a Sotheby's auction running October 14th to 21st, 2021, **the first NFT ever sold on Sotheby's Metaverse platform**. The winner also received a matching 1/1 Mothman promo card, the only one ever printed, and 100 booster boxes of Cryptid Nation: Nightfall 1st Edition.
- Sold price **$214,200**, of which Sotheby's kept **~$44,200** in premium, plus any negotiated seller's commission
